text: This report recommends a multi-year agreement between a Consumer Show Client and Exhibition Place within Enercare Centre.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved multi-year license agreements with the Consumer Show Client for Enercare Centre, as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, for a 3-year term commencing in each of 2022, 2023, and 2024 on the terms and conditions of the Licence Agreement, and such other terms and conditions satisfactory to the Chief Executive Officer and the City Solicitor. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential as it contains financial information, supplied in confidence to the Board, which, if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position or interfere significantly with the contractual or…
